# Post-hoc analyses (Kickoff 09 §2)

**Post hoc, not pre-registered.** Generated by `seat_swap.posthoc` from the run logs (P1, P1b, P2 = Qwen3-8B newcomer, P3 = gpt-oss-20b newcomer). Outcomes are recomputed from prices with `metrics.py`; `joins`, `enforces` and `re_formed` match each run's own summary. Rounds are relative to T = 150; shock at T+30. Games that stopped before an outcome's window are left out of its denominator (P2 `sib_full` s212, aborted at T+17).

Definitions (`metrics.py`): `back_at_cartel` = newcomer CI ≥ 0.9 in each of T+51..T+60 (no upper bound). `clean_punish` = newcomer CI ≥ 0.9 in each of T+27..T+29, both seats ≥ 1.70 in each of T+25..T+29, and newcomer ≤ 1.55 at T+31 or T+32. `clean_punish_return` = `clean_punish`, then newcomer CI ≥ 0.9 in at least one of the 6 rounds after the first round at ≤ 1.55 (the kickoff's `clean_punish_and_return`). Post-shock CI = mean over T+34..T+60.

Duplicate groups whose outcomes differ (same newcomer path, different incumbent path): 0.

Key tests on all games vs on unique paths only (one-sided Fisher exact, first arm higher):

| test | all games | p | unique paths only | p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pooled same_full > same_history, re_formed | same_full 10/30 vs same_history 1/30 | 0.0028 | same_full 10/29 vs same_history 1/30 | 0.0023 |
| P1b same_notes > same_history, re_formed | same_notes 8/15 vs same_history 1/15 | 0.0071 | same_notes 8/15 vs same_history 1/15 | 0.0071 |
| P1 same_history > same_none, joins | same_history 13/15 vs same_none 5/15 | 0.0039 | same_history 13/15 vs same_none 5/15 | 0.0039 |

Base games (P1 + P1b, rounds 1..150): 30 seeds, 1 distinct price paths (largest identical group 30); 30 of 30 are 1.92/1.92 in every round after the warm-up. The bases differ only in the notes, not in prices: effectively one cartel state.

One line: deduplicating identical paths leaves the pooled `same_full` vs `same_history` test at p = 0.0023.
